Class DiceExpression

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.dice.DiceExpression
public final class DiceExpression extends Object
A dice expression, such as 4d6dl1 or (1d20:critical>=20:miss=1)+STR+BONUS>=AC: a tree of DiceNodes that is parsed from a text, inspected, rolled, and whose chances are computed exactly. 
var attack = DiceExpression.parse("(1d20:critical>=20:miss=1)+STR+BONUS>=AC");
attack.variables();                           // [STR, BONUS, AC]

var bound = attack.bind(Map.of("STR", 3, "BONUS", 2, "AC", 15));
var rolled = bound.roll(random);
rolled.value();                               // 1 if the attack hits, 0 if it misses
rolled.tags();                                // [critical] if the die shows 20

var chances = bound.chances();
chances.of(1);                                // 11/20
chances.tagged("critical");                   // 1/20

Syntax

From the lowest precedence to the highest:

  • one comparison, = != < <= > >=, which evaluates to 1 if it holds and to 0 if not;
  • + -, then * /, from left to right; a division is rounded down;
  • a unary -;
  • dice, 3d6: a count, which is 1 if omitted, d, a number of sides or % for 100, then optionally which dice count in the sum: kh2 keeps the two highest, kl2 the two lowest, dh2 drops the two highest and dl2 the two lowest;
  • a whole number, a variable, whose name is made of upper-case letters, digits and underscores, or a group between parentheses.

A group may end with tags, each made of a colon and a name, optionally followed by conditions, each made of a comparison operator and a value: (2d10:attack:tier1<=11:tier2>=12<=16:tier3>=17). A tag with no condition always applies; the other ones apply when the value of the group satisfies all their conditions. Spaces are allowed anywhere but inside dice.

As a grammar: 

expression := sum (relation sum)?
relation   := '=' | '!=' | '<' | '<=' | '>' | '>='
sum        := product (('+' | '-') product)*
product    := unary (('*' | '/') unary)*
unary      := '-' unary | dice
dice       := primary? 'd' (primary | '%') keep? | primary
keep       := ('kh' | 'kl' | 'dh' | 'dl') number
primary    := number | variable | group
group      := '(' expression tag* ')'
tag        := ':' name (relation sum)*
number     := [0-9]+
variable   := [A-Z_] [A-Z0-9_]*
name       := [A-Za-z_] [A-Za-z0-9_]*

A number is at most Integer.MAX_VALUE. The parts of dice and of keep follow each other with no space in between.

Inspection

node() is the root of the tree, to walk from the top with a switch over the records of DiceNode. fold(Function) walks it from the bottom instead: the function is given each node with its children already replaced by what it returned for them. Everything else this class does is built on it. 

int dice = expression.<Integer>fold(node -> switch (node) {
    case DiceNode.Dice<Integer> d -> 1;
    default -> node.children().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
});

Expressions are immutable, and equal when their trees are.

Since:
0.2.0

    • bind

      public DiceExpression bind(Function<? super String, ? extends @Nullable DiceExpression> values)
      Returns this expression with each variable standing for what a function returns for its name, or left as it is if the function returns null. The function is called once per occurrence of a variable, and what it returns is evaluated again for each of them: dice in it are rolled once per occurrence. 
      expression.bind(name -> switch (name) {
    case "STR" -> DiceExpression.parse("3");
    case "SNEAK" -> DiceExpression.parse("3d6");
    default -> null;
});
      Parameters:
      values - what each variable stands for, by name
      Returns:
      the expression with the values

    • roll

      public RolledExpression roll(RandomGenerator random)
      Rolls the dice of this expression, from left to right, and evaluates it.

      Each die calls nextInt(sides) once, and shows that number plus one. The dice of a count and of a number of sides are rolled before the dice they count, and those of a group before those of the conditions of its tags. Nothing else uses the source of randomness.

      Parameters:
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      the tree of what each node evaluated to
      Throws:
      UnresolvedVariableException - if a variable has no value
      ArithmeticException - if a value overflows an int, on a division by zero, or if a number of dice is negative or more than 10,000, or a number of sides less than one

    • chances

      public DiceChances chances()
      Computes the exact chances of each outcome of this expression, without rolling.

      Dice that are kept or dropped aren't enumerated roll by roll: their faces are taken one at a time, counting the ways for each number of dice to show that face.

      Returns:
      the chances of each outcome
      Throws:
      UnresolvedVariableException - if a variable has no value
      ArithmeticException - if a value overflows an int, on a division by zero, if a number of dice is negative or more than 10,000, or a number of sides less than one, or if some dice have more than 1,000,000 sides in total
